title: Game runtime secrets
description: B1: the secrets scoped to one game runtime, as secrets.json beside its generation. Only this runtime's directory of the generations volume holds them. The control plane writes the file for every generation, with or without a password, before the generation itself; the runtime acts on neither file until both carry the same generation, so a missing or stale file never starts a world without its password.

generation.description: The generation these secrets belong to.

password.description: The world's password. Absent, the world has no password.
